proof: Stable labeled compression adds stability to labeled compression. Restricting the allowed compression functions cannot decrease the minimum size.
name: Stable Labeled Sample Compression / Labeled Sample Compression
witness_verification: At $n=5$ the stable value is three and the ordinary value is two, by the database-owned full-cube certificates. At $n=5r$ the stable value is $\lceil5r/2\rceil$ while the ordinary value is at most $2r$, so the additive gap is unbounded. Both values have linear order: this is not an unbounded-ratio witness.
